title: Pokemon Wugtrio ex 025/071 Wild Force Japanese sv5K Holo
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon card features the powerful Wugtrio ex, with a Japanese card size and language. It belongs to the Pokémon TCG game and has a speciality of EX, making it an exceptional addition to any collection. The card number is 025/071 and it is classified under the Attribute/MTG:Color category as Energy. The character portrayed on the card is Ace and it is recommended for ages 4+. This collectible card is perfect for any fan of the Pokémon franchise and is sure to impress with its unique features.
